name: telmoni-observability
description: Records each turn of your Claude Code sessions in Telmoni as a trace: the models and their tokens, the tools, the subagents and the times, and the tags you set. The conversation itself, your prompts and images, the replies and their plain-text thinking, each tool's input and output, only once you turn on Capture content and the project keeps content. Telmoni is privacy-first, open-source monitoring for AI agents.

TELMONI_API_KEY.title: Telmoni API key
TELMONI_API_KEY.description: A project API key with the ingest scope (tm_…), from the project's API keys page.

TELMONI_ENDPOINT.title: Telmoni endpoint
TELMONI_ENDPOINT.description: Leave empty for https://api.telmoni.com. A self-hosted Telmoni gives its machine host.

TELMONI_CAPTURE_CONTENT.title: Capture content
TELMONI_CAPTURE_CONTENT.description: Send each turn's conversation too: your prompts and their images, the replies and their plain-text thinking, each tool's input and output, each subagent's task and answer, each compaction's summary. Kept only where the project's content mode is on. A TELMONI_API_KEY in the environment takes TELMONI_CAPTURE_CONTENT=1 there instead.

TELMONI_SCRUB_SECRETS.title: Scrub secrets
TELMONI_SCRUB_SECRETS.description: Before content leaves, replace each secret in it (a key, a token, a password, a private key, a connection string) with a marker such as [secret: aws_key], counted on the trace's page. A TELMONI_API_KEY in the environment takes TELMONI_SCRUB_SECRETS=0 there instead.

TELMONI_SCRUB_PII.title: Scrub personal data
TELMONI_SCRUB_PII.description: Before content leaves, replace personal data in it (emails, phone numbers, card numbers, IP addresses, home folders' paths) with a marker such as [pii: email], counted on the trace's page; no pattern finds a name or a street address. A TELMONI_API_KEY in the environment takes TELMONI_SCRUB_PII=0 there instead.
